review_passed_meaning: The final narrative, current status, new daily entry and indexes accurately describe scoped completed evidence and NO_GO. This is not candidate acceptance, package execution, push verification or overall Goal completion.
method: Read the final report and current sections/indexes; reuse completed prerequisite/history reviews and final matrix/resource reviews; compare 25 displayed table rows at their published precision to independently reviewed summaries. No original responses, runtime logs, resource CSVs or model files were rescanned for this review.

checks.name: identity_and_fixed_scope
checks.detail: One default-off candidate, same tested binary for A/B/C, fixed 11 quality + 63 history + 36 matrix = 110 HTTP; 17-step terminal collection is explicitly separate from performance acceptance.

checks.name: quality_and_numeric_limits
checks.detail: 11 bounded reference-compatible requests, cap32/actual7 EOS; missing status codes disclosed. 157 host/tool contracts, three selected numerical contracts, 13 BF16 comparisons and 11 FP32 observations reported with layer/small-shape limitations.

checks.name: history_permanent_veto
checks.detail: All seven history rows match reviewed rounding and gates; failed positions 2/4/6/7 remain a permanent veto. No sample addition/exclusion or retrospective change to the old NO_GO.

checks.name: BC_noncausal_description
checks.detail: Seven mean-decode differences and the retained B45K third TTFT match the history review. Fixed A/B/C order and time/cache/scheduling confounding prohibit isolated fprintf-cost or statistical claims.

checks.name: matrix_complete_and_exact_gates
checks.detail: All six rows match reviewed rounding. 1K minimum decode -0.006640789% and 4K -0.103982198% remain failed exact gates without an epsilon or statistical-significance claim; 4K first TTFT also fails. Target capacity is 261887+257=262144.

checks.name: execution_path_and_usage_limits
checks.detail: Quiet C decode partition absence is supported by full diag/request/layer alignment; history singleton retention is preserved. Matrix SSE usage absence is explicitly disclosed; DB token columns and normalized records supply the bounded length check. Diags precede computation and do not prove full-model numerics.

checks.name: resource_definitions_and_tables
checks.detail: Six PID read_bytes/rchar rows and six memory rows match reviewed values. PID all-file storage reads, logical reads, cgroup/device counters, current/peak and NVIDIA observations remain separate.

checks.name: resource_missingness_and_54GB
checks.detail: 100 client envelopes, 22850 samples, 99 cgroup/PID disagreements, 62 zero-cgroup/positive-PID cases, 1.122s/11.003s observation gaps, missing livecache/PSI and unknown physical RAM union remain explicit. Cgroup swap0 is separate from observed whole-system swap1329594368..1599184896 bytes. Overall54GB is INDETERMINATE.

checks.name: protection_scope_and_chronology
checks.detail: Full frozen export check precedes resource audit; final protection follows it. Corrected wording only places both before final docs. MAIN seven diffs/binary/HEAD and model metadata are scoped snapshots; no payload-byte or reference-whole-tree proof is claimed.

checks.name: conditional_exit
checks.detail: Business/lifecycle NOT_TRIGGERED, old20 generations/21 checks not reused as execution proof, no second candidate/default enable/merge/deploy.

checks.name: status_log_indexes
checks.detail: Current status and new daily entry agree with the final narrative and distinguish collected contracts from performance NO_GO; report and log index paths are correct. Historical entries remain historical, not new runtime claims.

checks.name: delivery_paths_and_boundaries
checks.detail: Three report packet links and the new log evidence link resolve to the planned packager destinations. They are prospective at this review; packet/commit/push receipts are not asserted to exist.

resolved_findings.finding: Original phrase placed the complete export check after resource audit, although its recorded timestamp was immediately before the audit.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root removed the opening resource-audit chronology qualifier before final report hashing. No evidence, threshold or runtime changed.

pending_delivery_checks.required: Create once using the reviewed packager; validate all report/log evidence links after packaging.
Copy exact reviewed summary bytes to this target.
Bind the full local raw manifest, preserving local-only/non-portable boundary.
Record actual later commit/push identity separately from tested runtime source; not covered by this review.
Complete the final itemized check only after package and publication work are actually finished.

limitations: Prior raw quality/history reviews were reused; matrix and resource raw verification is delegated to their named final reviews with their own stated limits.
This review does not rerun any model/test/audit, recreate any process snapshot, or claim whole-tree immutability.
Final package manifest must bind this exact report and review; any later final-document edit invalidates this report binding and needs a bounded recheck.
